Usage: pkcs11-check [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                                                        
                                                                                                                        
 CLI-first PKCS#11 test suite with segfault survival and interface forcing.                                             
                                                                                                                        
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --log-level                 [debug|info|warning|error|critical]  Log level [default: INFO]                           │
│ --trace                                                          Trace PKCS#11 calls                                 │
│ --install-completion                                             Install completion for the current shell.           │
│ --show-completion                                                Show completion for the current shell, to copy it   │
│                                                                  or customize the installation.                      │
│ --help                                                           Show this message and exit.                         │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ test               Run the PKCS#11 test suite against a module.                                                      │
│ doctor             Diagnose a PKCS#11 module setup and print the next step for any problem.                          │
│ info               Show PKCS#11 module information: version, slots, mechanisms.                                      │
│ list               List available PKCS#11 test categories.                                                           │
│ list-tests         Enumerate pytest node-ids matching a selection, one per line to stdout.                           │
│ state              Inspect isolated runner state and adaptive policy files.                                          │
│ compliance-report  Generate machine-readable PKCS#11 compliance report.                                              │
│ compare-coverage   Compare provider-local mechanism coverage states between two artifacts.                           │
│ compare-results    Compare two pkcs11-check results.json files and report regressions.                               │
│ fetch-data         Download third-party test vectors.                                                                │
│ fetch-disabled     Download the disabled-tests baseline from GitHub.                                                 │
│ shard-units        Plan N balanced shards of test FILES (heavy files spread via LPT).                                │
│ merge-shards       Merge N shard artifact directories into one combined result set.                                  │
│ crash-calls        Show, per crashed unit, the last C_* call before the crash + its journal file.                    │
│ differential       Diff N providers' KAT verdicts and report the odd-one-out per disagreeing node-id.                │
│ evidence-export    Export a raw report.jsonl stream to a semantic evidence ledger.                                   │
│ evidence-admit     Admit a lane ledger against its roster and obligation inventory.                                  │
│ evidence-compare   Compare baseline vs candidate ledgers for one lane under rotation deltas.                         │
│ version            Show pkcs11-check version.                                                                        │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

snapshots.canonical_stdout: Usage: pkcs11-check list-tests [OPTIONS] [TARGETS]... Enumerate pytest node-ids matching a selection, one per line to stdout. For building disabled-tests files without repeated live runs (issue #6). Node-ids are forward-slash on every platform. Diagnostics go to stderr, so ``list-tests --match X > disabled.txt`` yields a clean file. ╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮ │ targets [TARGETS]... Paths to scope collection (default: all test cases) │ ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯ ╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮ │ --match TEXT Node-id name pattern (pytest -k) │ │ --marker TEXT Marker expression (pytest -m) │ │ --category -c TEXT Category (pytest -k) │ │ --skip-slow Exclude slow tests │ │ --only-slow Only slow tests │ │ --module -m PATH Optional module: enumerate mechanism-driven variants too │ │ --interface -i [auto|2.40|3.0|3.1|3.2] Interface version [default: auto] │ │ --slot INTEGER Slot index [default: 0] │ │ --include-disabled Also list node-ids the configured disabled baseline excludes │ │ --help Show this message and exit. │ ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

snapshots.canonical_stdout: Usage: pkcs11-check shard-units [OPTIONS] Plan N balanced shards of test FILES (heavy files spread via LPT). With ``--format lines`` (default) prints one shard per line as a space-separated file list — consumable by a shell launcher. With ``json`` prints ``{"shards": [, ...]}``. ╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮ │ * --shards -n INTEGER Number of shards (>=1) [required] │ │ --testcases PATH Directory of test files to shard [default: src/pkcs11_check/testcases] │ │ --prior-results PATH A prior results.json; per-file durations balance shards (LPT) │ │ --format TEXT Output: 'lines' (one shard/line) or 'json' [default: lines] │ │ --help Show this message and exit. │ ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

Usage: pkcs11-check test [OPTIONS] [TARGETS]...                                                                        
                                                                                                                        
 Run the PKCS#11 test suite against a module.                                                                           
                                                                                                                        
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│   targets      [TARGETS]...  Optional pytest paths or nodeids                                                        │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *  --module           -m      PATH                     Path to PKCS#11 module [required]                             │
│    --interface        -i      [auto|2.40|3.0|3.1|3.2]  Interface version [default: auto]                             │
│    --timeout          -t      INTEGER                  Per-test timeout (seconds) [default: 180]                     │
│    --category         -c      TEXT                     Test categories                                               │
│    --match                    TEXT                     Test name pattern                                             │
│    --marker                   TEXT                     Pytest marker expression (-m)                                 │
│    --skip-slow                                         Fast profile: skip long-running tests (-m 'not slow')         │
│    --only-slow                                         Run only the long-running tests (-m 'slow')                   │
│    --pin                      TEXT                     PIN (prefer P11TEST_PIN env)                                  │
│    --so-pin                   TEXT                     SO PIN for CKU_SO tests (prefer P11TEST_SO_PIN env)           │
│    --slot                     INTEGER                  Slot index [default: 0]                                       │
│    --output,--format  -o      TEXT                     Output: rich, json, junit [default: rich]                     │
│    --output-file              TEXT                     Output file path                                              │
│    --verbose          -V                               Verbose output                                                │
│    --show-config                                       Print effective config (value + source per key) and exit      │
│    --help                                              Show this message and exit.                                   │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Advanced ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --sessions               -s      INTEGER  Concurrent sessions [default: 1]                                           │
│ --destructive                             Enable destructive tests                                                   │
│ --ignore-disabled-tests                   Do not load the configured disabled baseline for this run                  │
│ --no-collection-cache                     Disable the cached collection metadata (always re-collect from scratch)    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Isolation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --isolation                   TEXT                  Isolation mode: auto, file, test, none (auto is default; none is │
│                                                     fastest but unsafe)                                              │
│                                                     [default: auto]                                                  │
│ --resume                                            Continue a saved isolated run; skip targets already attempted    │
│ --stop-on-failure                                   Stop isolated mode at the first failing/crashing unit            │
│ --state-file                  PATH                  State file for isolated runs                                     │
│                                                     [default: .pkcs11-check-isolation-state.json]                    │
│ --policy-file                 PATH                  Adaptive isolation policy file for isolated runs                 │
│                                                     [default: .pkcs11-check-isolation-policy.json]                   │
│ --max-crashes-per-file        INTEGER RANGE [x>=0]  In test/auto isolation, skip remaining tests from a file after   │
│                                                     this many crashes (0 = unlimited; default 10). Abandoned tests   │
│                                                     are reported as crash_limited.                                   │
│                                                     [default: 10]                                                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ CK_RV tracing ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --rv-trace                   Record each C_* call's raw CK_RV per test into report.jsonl user_properties             │
│ --rv-trace-compact        N  Keep only the last N CK_RV trace entries per test (implies --rv-trace)                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Key provisioning ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --key-inject                      TEXT     Key-provisioning injection mode: off, unwrap, force-unwrap [default: off] │
│ --wrap-key-source                 TEXT     Wrapping KEK source: bootstrap (auto-generate) or configured              │
│                                            [default: bootstrap]                                                      │
│ --wrap-key-label                  TEXT     Label of the configured wrapping key                                      │
│ --wrap-key-handle                 INTEGER  Handle of the configured wrapping key                                     │
│ --wrap-key-value                  TEXT     Hex value of a symmetric configured KEK (prefer P11TEST_WRAP_KEY_VALUE    │
│                                            env)                                                                      │
│ --wrap-mech                       TEXT     Override auto-selected unwrap mechanism (e.g. CKM_RSA_AES_KEY_WRAP)       │
│ --wrap-rsa-bits                   INTEGER  RSA key size in bits for bootstrap wrapping key [default: 2048]           │
│ --wrap-oaep-hash                  TEXT     OAEP hash for wrapping: auto (probe; prefer sha256, fall back sha1),      │
│                                            sha1, or sha256                                                           │
│                                            [default: auto]                                                           │
│ --allow-external-provision                 Strict acknowledgement enabling external-tool provisioning (requires      │
│                                            --external-provision-cmd)                                                 │
│ --external-provision-cmd          TEXT     Operator command template loading a key into the backend; placeholders    │
│                                            {keyfile} {label} {key_type} {key_class}                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Daemon recovery ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --recover-mode        TEXT  Crashing-daemon recovery: off (default), wait (pause for an external supervisor to       │
│                             restart the daemon), or cmd (run --recover-cmd). Use wait if anything else restarts it.  │
│                             [default: off]                                                                           │
│ --recover-cmd         TEXT  No-shell argv (tokenized) run between tests when the provider is detected down; implies  │
│                             --recover-mode cmd. Only for daemons nothing else restarts.                              │
│                             [env var: P11TEST_RECOVER_CMD]                                                           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Selection ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --selection-manifest        PATH       Path to an exact case batch selection manifest                                │
│ --vendor-mechanism          NAME=0xID  Vendor mechanism code point, e.g. KMAC_128=0x80001234 (repeatable)            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
